Paracetamol 2 tablets up to four times daily for the first few days if feverish or weak

Assessment.content: Acute gastroenteritis with watery diarrhea for 3 days approximately 6–7 times per day, intermittent left lower abdominal cramping, transient vomiting at onset, subjective feverishness, and no blood in stool or vomit while tolerating fluids
Assessment.source_text: 1. **Acute gastroenteritis** — watery diarrhea x3 days (~6–7/day) + intermittent L lower abd cramping, transient vomiting at onset, subjective feverishness, no blood in stool/vomit; tolerating fluids.

Plan_of_Care.content: Conservative management for acute gastroenteritis with no antibiotics advised
Use oral rehydration solution such as Dioralyte
Take paracetamol 2 tablets up to four times daily for the first few days if feeling feverish or weak
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Paracetamol** 2 tabs up to QID x first few days if feverish/weak

Plan_of_Care.content: Rest and take time off work for 2–3 days
Follow up if not improving in 3–4 days and consider stool sample or testing if symptoms are ongoing
Plan_of_Care.source_text: F/u if not improving in **3–4 days**; consider stool sample/testing if ongoing
